name: CSF_ABORTED
meaning: set by Wolf msg 0xe (preempted); suppresses the Wolf unfreeze and the auto-reset on 0x4f; cleared by MSG_USE and Reset

name: CSF_RUNTIME_MASK
meaning: CanonSimple::Reset: csFlags &= 0xffffff00 clears the low byte; the constant is the complement of the literal (inferred)

name: CSF_FIRE_ARMED
meaning: set on each aim frame without a fire/exit press; required to fire

name: CSF_AIM_CAM_STARTED
meaning: aim camera already sent; cleared on entering state 1

name: CSF_AIM_CHANGED
meaning: aim moved this frame (camera and ApplyAim refresh)

name: CSF_WOLF_FROZEN
meaning: this cannon sent the Wolf msg 0xe; msg 0xf on release

name: CSF_ANALOG_ACCEL
meaning: proportional analog aim step (set at Init, never cleared)

name: CSF_RESET_AIM
meaning: Reset restores defaultAim; never set by any code (dead)
